x2c_pyscf_real.note: Open-source X2C SOC reference for the BDF wrapper. Real PySCF 2.13 run on the test machine (macOS arm64). Three-stage analysis: non-rel + scalar X2C + two-component X2C+SOC, all converged. Detail: runs_archive/x2c_pyscf/result.json. Run script: scripts/benchmarks/run_anthracene_pyscf_x2c.py.

also_validated_at.note: Same trends; sto-3g 13× faster and used as the smoke test for the unit-test suite.

x2c_pyscf_real.interpretation: Sub-meV SOC correction is the chemically expected result for a pure C/H molecule (no heavy atoms). It demonstrates that the ChemMaster -> calc_pyscf -> X2C SOC call path is functional end-to-end and chemistry-faithful, even though sto-3g absolute energies are not quantitatively comparable to BDF / Niu-Shuai 2008.

pipeline_full_mock.note: Original full Gaussian + BDF + MOMAP TVCF pipeline placeholder. The k_r / k_p numbers below are taken from literature error ranges and require real BDF + MOMAP licences to be replaced by real data. ChemMaster's calc_bdf and calc_momap MCP wrappers are implemented (chemaster/mcp/calc_bdf, chemaster/mcp/calc_momap) but cannot run without those licences on the test machine.
